method: Least-squares camera resection from manually picked image points of OSM footprint vertices (scripts/solve_camera.py). Ground points (z = 0) constrain position, heading and FOV; points high on the same vertical edges contribute only their horizontal residual with height left free, so they constrain pitch and roll without using any building height.
pickedBy: Sunvision maintainers, by inspecting web/public/examples/sarajevo-obala-kulina-bana/photo.jpg (2000x1333); estimated picking accuracy ±10–15 px
fixedNote: Two corners cannot separate FOV from distance (a free FOV within hfovRange runs to its 62.2° bound for 0.8 px less RMS), so the solve holds the EXIF value; hfovRange is written to the scene as the app's alignment bound.
hfovRangeNote: EXIF FocalLength 18 mm ± 0.5 mm (rounding) on a 22.3–23.0 mm sensor width (Canon spec vs. EXIF FocalPlaneXResolution); the file keeps the sensor's 3:2 aspect, so no crop.

note: Only the two outer corners are used: OSM's centre way (way/190229449, 7.1 m) is narrower than the raised centre bay in the photo (≈ 13 m), so the inner OSM vertices do not mark visible edges. Vertex indices refer to each building's ring in scene.base.json.
